MgIp to ItGGP this book IfGsh 4 clean Ki Sur Jingkvnud Ha Ka Jingim Kj Sur Jingkynud Ha Ka Jingim, ki dei ki sur rwai myllung, kiba la kyrsoi na ki sap ki phong i Kong Pdianglin Phanbuh, ia kaba i la sei pynpaw pyrthei, ban ia sam lang ha ngi ki khun Hynniewtrep. Wat lada kane ka jingpyrshang ka long tang kum i umpohliew, hynrei ki long kiba sngur khlir khlir, kiba shngiam, kiba bang bad ai jingtngen, kiba ngam bad tuid sha ki thwei ka sain pyrkhat-ka sain pyrdain, jong ka loingbriew ka manbreiw. Ki long ki sur kiba kren bad purom-khana ia ka Jingshai ka Mynnor, jong ki juk ka Aiom Ksiar ki 'ni ki kong, naduh ba la seng ia ka thymmei ka tynrai jongngi ki Hynniewtrep; ki sur kiba kren ia ki jinglong bad jingshisha ka Mynta; ki sur kiba ai ka sneng ka kraw, khamtam ia ki khun ki pyrsa samla samhoi, kiba btin ia ki sha ki thiong jingkyrmen, jong ki lashai Ngin ia kit bok kit n/viang ia i Kong Pdiang, ban nym shongthait, hynrei ba in nang iai bteng ban pyndonkam ia ki sap ba la ai u Nongbuh u Nongthaw, hapdeng ka shait, ka koit, ka khiah krat khiah sting.

Khubiei Sumar Sing Sawian, Raij' Mawbuh, Umroi, Ri Bhoi. Nohprah, - 2006) 1 Ki kvntien svllok Ka long kaei kaei kaba sngewtynnad haduh katta katta ba I Kong Pdiangtin Phanbuh I la lah ban thoh poitri kaba in sa pynmih pyrthei shen. Kane ka thup poitri ka kyrteng “Ki Sur Jingkynud Ha Ka Jingim”. Nyngkong eh nga ai khublei ia i ba i la pynpaw la ka jong ka sap ka phong ba kordor ba la ai u Blei nongbuh non^haw, ba im shym la tyngkai sohthad ban buh tang ha la ka jingmut jingpyrkhat jong i; hynrei i la sei madan ia ki ban sam lem ha ngi, kito kiba ieit ban pule khamtam lei la ka Jong. Kane ka jingpyrshang ba nyngkong Jong i kan long u synfiiang u bynhei sha u sup u thiar Jong ka thoh poitri Khasi. Ka paw ba i nongthoh i long iba ieit bha la ka tynrai na ki poim Jong i hi. I la pynpaw ruh ia ki Jingkyrsoi ba mih na tyllong ka dohnud Jong i ha ka Jingtyllun ki shalyntem Jong ka por, la ka long ia ka mynnor ne mynta. Kumba don ka Jingong ba “haba ka ktien ka im, ka Jaitbynriew ka im”, ka long ka Jingshisha ba ngi riTai pynim ia la ka Jaitbynriew na ki kam thoh Jong ngi, la ka long ha ka thoh poitri, nobel ne thoh drama. Hooid, i kong pdiang i la sdang ban thoh poitri ha la ka Jingsngewthuh jong i, ym Ju don ka poitri kaba bha ne kaba sniew.

Baroh ka shong ha ka Jingnang Jong ngi ban pule bad burom ia kiei kaba ki Jingthoh ki thoh. Dei hangta ba ngi lah ban kyntiew ia ka thoh ka tar Jong ngi. Kyntang waiwot, nga kit bok kit rwiang ia i nongthoh ba in nang Yai pyrshang shuh ban pynmih pyrthei sa ia kiwei de kt Jingthoh khnang ba litereshor Khasi ruh kan nang heh nang far To nang koit nang khiah khnang ba phin long ka Tit khmih ia ka Jaitbynriew na ki kam Jong phi. Khublei Prof. Streamlet Dkhar “Casa Pietatis” Golflinks Khlieh Shnong Shillong - 1 29 tarik Taiong, 2008 2 ‘^Shi Kyntien Ar Kyntien ” Kane ka dei ka sien kaba nyngkong ha kaba nga la pynmih madan ia ka kot poitri kaba nga ai kyrteng “Ki Sur Jingkynud ha ka Jingim". Nga dap da ka jingsngewnguh ia kito kiba la ai mynsiem bad pynshlur ia nga ha ka ban pynmih madan ia ki jingthoh jongnga. Khamtam ia i Kong Hasina Kharbih i ba la pynshlur ia nga ha ka ban thoh. I Bah Sumar Sawian i ba la ai ka jing kitbok kitrwiang ia nga ban tur shaphrang bad ban nym kynrandien ha ka jingpynmih ia ki jingthoh jongnga bad khamtam eh i Dr. (Kong) Streamlet Dkhar, i Vice President jong ka All India Poet Conference, iba long ma i, i nong plie lynti ia nga.

Nga kyrmen skhem ba kane ka jingai mynsiem jong ki kan btin lynti ha ki jingthoh jongnga Khublei Shibun Pdiangiin Phanbuh Nongthoh 209, Lower Lachaumiere Shillong. 1 mat p 3it No. Pyrthei mynta 4 1. KA lING JINGLONG KHYNNAH. iing jinglong khynnah jong nga. Ha jingkynmaw ia pha, long Mawbynna Wat la kiwei ki shong ha pha mynta Ha mynsiem jong nga. pha don la ka bynta. Tang jingkynmaw ieit kan neh kyndong. Pha dei ka iing ha kaba nga la shong Ha manwei shaphang jong pha nga pyrkhat la por jinglong khynnah ba sngewtynnad. Kawei-pa-kawei ka kyndong nga kynmaw bha Dei ha pha longiing la seng kaba paka I Mei-I Pa - bad baroh lang shipara Ah; sa shisien kynmaw, por sngewbha.

Kumba ju long, ha jingim, u bynriew, Ki jingsngewsih ha pha ngi la kyntiew Ki por jong ummat kthang ka jingim Ha pha sngewlem bynta, la ia shim. Haduh mynta jingmutdur wan ha nga, Kumno ngi pynriam pynbeit ia pha Ngi sait bad shut madan khlem salia, Sngewsarong haba ikhuid bad thaba. Kumno ki mawkyndon jong pha ki kiew Shuwa ban rung na lynti laid briew Bunsien ki marjan lok baieit ki pyrta Nangno ngi khmih mynta shat shynna Shano ki jingkhang iit jongpha ki phai? Jingkhang-bah shano kamra, sam lyngba Hangno kamra baroh ngi sngewtynnad bha Dei Yng shet ja ban ia lum Sngap khana Ha pha ngi loh jingsneng ba iai sawa, Lem jingpyni da ‘tien ieit i Mei i Pa Dei ha pha kein jingim briew ka sdang Ngi ithuh ia kur, ia kha, ia man 5 Te, kumno kein jingkynmaw ieit kin duh? Haba ha pha bun jingjia nga ia kynduh. Wat la shawei mynta nga shong Jingkynmaw ieit ia pha kan neh junom. “KA LYNGSHOP JONG KA POR” Kum ka ‘leilieh kaba thaba ha lyoh uba paw Shano mo u slap, wat tang u ‘lap praw? Balei ka sngi, kumba dom ka shit kyrang? Katba mynsiem, jingpyrkhat longbriew ki pawang.

Kumno kumne ha ri Khasi-Jaintia jong ngi: Ka sang ka ma i kumba la wan prat lynti Ym don shuh ka kheift burom kynthei, khynnah Naphang ki lyngshop, da ki jingtieng ki tawah. Haei ki 'riew pyrkhat’? Haei ki ‘riew pyrdaih? Haei ka jingtiplem? Ka la Ieit mo sha u Thien Dei mo kane u hyndai u khot ka “Kuli Juk” Ta iingshongbriew ruh ka ksam ka kynjut. Katba dangiaid ki sngi, jingtynjuh nangwan I kumba “nemsniew ka wan ban synran Ko Ri Khasi-Jaintia “Ko Ri baieit ki Blei” Kumno jingkylli por rhynta, ha dohnud iwei pa iwei Ki kynrem ki lyndan ki ai jingbatai, jingkren, Tano phin ngeit? hangno keih phin pynskhem? Ka shem ha la marwei, tang uta keih u tip Ta jingpang dohnud, kumno un kput, un pynlip. Baroh baroh ki ong ngi pyrkhat ia ka lawei Dei mo ma ngi mynta ban ksan ban khiei?

Lada haba dang-lung iohi ia jingshyrkhei Da kaei keih pynshongdor haba kumtei? Kl KYNTIEN Ki sur ba mih na Shyntur. la jinglong briew ka ring dur. U Thyliiej ba khlem shyieng Padiah Sur ieit ne ka jingsyier Wat dur la ka sniew. ‘Tien jem ‘tien donakor ring briew ‘Tien khor. tien khlem akor La bhabriew duh noh ka dor Jingim ha man la u briew Da kyntien la kyrdan ka kyntiew ‘Tien biej, tien pynshoh biej Shukor wat ia jait bynriew. ‘Tien ieit, tien sneng I Mei I Pa. Barabor ka lam sha jingbha Wat hateng hateng da tien mai, Kyntien ha jingim ruh kan rai. Ka Sur Kyntien u Blei la ai Kumta Sumar bha wat leh kai.

Da tien ieit pynphriang janai Khnang kyrteng, pyrto haduh ia shai 4. “LA KA JONG’* Ko khun Khasi Khara. Ba dang bat dustur Wat hapdeng bun ki lingkyc i 3ym klet ia bo bt-h U 'fu. j Ka shad ka kmen ba dang la bat, Ban nguh i u Bie» ba iah ba pyndap Ha shad suk mynsiem ne shad syiem Dang iai pyrshang pynphuh pynphieng. 7 Shaduh ‘Sohpetbneng paidbah u kiew Jaka ki ong, “sdang Khasi bynriew” Hangne shim khaw ban eh ka rngiew Dih ia ka um da jingdap mynsiem. Ko khun khasi Khara wat pait wat pra To ia tylli kawei wat nym sakma U Khasi, u Pnar, u Bhoi, U War Ka juh hi ka thymmei, ngi ia par. Ka jait u bynriew' rit paid ngi long To ngin ia kynmaw la ka jong kyndon Wat jingstad kylleng pyrthei ngi prong Barabor sngewsarong ia la ka jong. ka riam ka beit ngi don la ka jong Ha riam Shad ‘lei yn nai ia ong Hangno pyrthei shem kum ka jong ngi Khamtam ka riam kynthei, donburom hi. Ka kyrdan bynriew ngi da pynshong I Bah, i hep, i kong, i Ma ngi ong kane burom ha shad hi to puson Rangbah ia kynthei ki ker kyndong.

Ko Para Khasi Khara to sngew to pyni Jingsneng tymmen ha khun man ka sngi Khnang kin tip ia dustur riti, la jong hi Kaba da paka ka don ha ri jong ngi. “KA BUROM IA LONGKMiE” Longbriew manbriew ha pyrthei U Blei la buh Kynthei shynrang baroh ar bynriew la ithuh Ka juh ka rukom baroh ar, sla pyrthei long bynriew Hynrei balei pat pynpher ia kyrdan da u briew 8 Dei mo ki ong kynthei briew ka long shi bor Namar u Rangkhadar bor pyni jingkordor Hynrei iada ngam jylliew bha ha jingpyrkhat, la “Ka shibor”, barabor ym don ba lah lait. Long-iing longsem ba khia ha longkmie, pynkit Balei kein ki Rangbah ba bun ki iaid khap blip Katta ruh longkmie kim dei ban shukan weibriew Ta jingshem baroh, ha para kynthei to phylliew. Da jingpyrkhat lang, longkmie lynti kin shem Ha kano ka rukom pat para kynthei, iarap lem, Pyrthei mynta ka plie bun ki lad ki lynti Jingia-snoh kti, jingsniew yn rat tylli. Ngi sngewsarong ban ong “Longkmie Khasi” Naduh mynhyndai ia ki Rangbah, ju ai kti Ha lyngkha ne ha khaii, ngi tip bad iohi, Kumta ma ki, ruh ia kyrdan ki sngewthuh hi. Ha kine ki por lei lei ngin nai ia ong, Ha kano ka Jait Jingtrei, kynthei kim don Katno longkmie man ha ki phang ki paw khmat, Hynrei aiu kein kin leh, jingsniew pynduh jait. Longkmie barabor dei ma ki ba kham angnud, Jingsuk ha ling, ri, pyrthei jingim laitluid Ma ki, ki tip bha aiu Iada shong shngaih ym don, Longbriew - khynnah, samla, tymmen kin kyllon. “KI SYRWET JINGPYRKHAT” Pyrthei mynta, Jingkylli “kumno kumne” la shaiong lut baroh longpa longkmie Kaei ka jia, hapoh mynsiem shu lyng-a, Shano keift yn wad ia kaei kaba shisha. Dei mo ka por ne ka jingleh-bor, Bynriew ia hok kim da khein kor.

9 Biang shimet, jingpyrkhat barobor, Kiwei kin jia, khlem salia, shet shukor. Shano kata ba ki ong, “Burom akor Khasi” Da jingbymsalia ia bynriew, mih pli, La kf^i, kmie, kpa baroh sha kyndong, Khamtam ki por samla, por beh rongphong. Ka kyntien ia tymmen, ia kro kylla khongpong Da ‘tien khlem akor, ki khlei da jingsarong Balei keih kumne, long ha jingim u bynriew; La dei ban ong, “synshar ka nem-sniew”. Ko rympei sneng, mynta, shano pha poi? Balei katne ka jingsniew ha ri ka roi Ym khein ia tymmen, kynthei, khynnah, Naphang, balei katne "Ko por pha tynrah”. “LUM KUR LUM JAID” Jingkyrsiew, buh u hyndai, kyndit bynriew Haba Rangbah, longkfii ki sdang kyntiew Da jingtrei shitom ia kur ia jaid ban wad Ban pynlong ka jingiakynduh bun paid. Khnang ba kawei longiing ia kawei kan ithuh Wat la heh, rit, duk, riewspah ym ia tynjuh namar na ka juh, ka thymmei, baroh ki par Kumta ka kur ia jingiatylli kan wanrah. Ha Lumkur, khi, iathuh ia jingsdang jong ka Khnang naduh khynnah ban nangri bad da, Namar u hyndai u duh bad nam ia ka Kumta, ngi pat sumar ia kyrteng jong ka. Haba laid harum haneng, kum u Khasi, kylli.

Nyngkong nyngshap ia i Jaid i khong jong phi. Da akor baroh jubab, pyni katno ngi sarong, la kyntien ba bud dien ia ka kyrteng la jong. 10 Sa shisien pyrta “lum kur ba kordor”, da jingkmen Hangne ngi ithuh kfii, metnah, para hynmen, Da ka akor bad burom, kyntien na iwei sha iwei Jingsdang khein kor para Khasi, ban bha ka lawei. “BABE KYLLA” Katba nangVaid ki por, ha mynsiem nga sahnud barobor, fa kiei kiei, ym shim pyndep, Ha jingkynmaw ba kwah ban syrdep. Bale!? nga ong halade marwei, Dei mo ka por ne dang bieit. Ne jingpyrkhat duna lynti plie fa bym shym leh, mynta pat babe. Jingtieng ne jinglehraih khanglad, Hynrei, balei pat, jingsawa wei briew, fa kine kiei kiei ngam kwah pynpaw, Lynga hapoh mynsiem, ka daw “Jynba ngan da pyndep", nga ong, “Mo”, 'Jingkylla ha ka jingim ngan sah pyrto" Ah; Balei, bun sien ngan iai kylli, Mynsiem, ka pang, marwei sngewthuh hi! “JINGBISHNI” Ka biah khongrai kylleng ka ‘Ri’ Dei mo ki ong ka jingbishni Ban bha kiwei ym sngewlah shah Pynsniew ia kyrteng, pyrshang thawlad.

Kum jingbampong ha mynsiem ka shong, Ki matpeit hateng ki shad sawdong Kumno yn thawlad, ringdur ha weibriew Shlip tang ioh lad, jingmut ki dem tliew. 11 Ki Ktien khongwaiA kum u jyrmi, Da ‘tien thaw pyntuid kum ‘tien lorni’ Ksam, piam la kum tyllai ha diengjri Sbak pynhap kamon kadiang, tynrai ha kliar. U jyrmi ba ksam, kjit jingbam na u dieng Ki ai ‘tien ban ngam ha dohnud briew, Ban lam sha jingpait jingpra longiing Wat haduh ka ri ne jaidbynhew. Ha sur kyntien lah ban sngewthuh, Jingpun ha mynsiem, khana pynpur, Ha shyntur briew ka par suki Jai Tad longbriew hangta ka shai kdar. Ka kwah palat, ia bor ban tynjuh, Jinglong teng teng ym sngewthuh. Da kyntien shit ne kyntien ksam, Siat pharshi khamtam, tang tur shajan. Ah: ko Jingbishni pha del kaei shisha? Dei mb mapha ka Jingsniew sdang thikna. Ym kheih ba ha iing, paralok ne shi para, Pha dei shisha jingpang kaba i kynsha.

“KA JINGSNGEW-NGUH” Sa shisien, sa shisien Ka Jingsawa na ka shyntur, ka wan Ka por ba ka kur, kan iaium lang, Ngi ai khublei ia iongkmie, longkhi Jingtrei minot bad sani Jong ki. la kur shisien shisnem pyniakynduh Iwei pa iwei kham sngewjan bad ithuh Khamtam kan wanrah Jingieit, teh song la kiba shong ha sor bad nongkyndong. Teng teng ngi sngew ba ngi long marwei. Hynrei kum khun Khasi, ha snieh pyrthei. 12 Ngi long kiba donbok shisha, ym dei? Namar ngi don ka kur, kdup iwei pa iwei. Katba shaphrang ka por ka laid, Kumta jingmut jingpyrkhat nangiar Wat ha jinglong ba dang khynnah rit Da jingialang kur ki sdang ban tip. Ta ka hynnin kaba jia, yn-nai ia bat Mynta to ia map, longkur to ia sngap Ha ka pang, jynjar, shitom to rap to da la ka kur ka jaid to wat ai kan sakma. Sa shisien, sa shisien ha jingialang ka Kur Ha la ka mynsiem to iaroh Pyrta ieit meinah, meisan, mama Kumjuh ruh ia kyrshan, hynmen, para.

“KA BAM PONG IA JINGIM” Kumno jingim u briew ka troin Jingong “Ka Jingduk Jingkyrduh” kyntien Kane tang ia ka spah hi kam thew, Dei ka mynsiem briew kumne ka kdew. Ka kwah tynneng, Jingjot ka lam Ki kmie ki kpa ia daw dei ban ksam Ta khun ia kti, wat ju klet ban kylli Jingshem jing-ia-kynduh man ka sngi. Lada ym don Jaka shano ban phai Samla khamtam ki nangthaw daw Sha jot ban poi khlem jingpyrkhat Namar ym don ban batai ne sympat. Ka juk haba ia u dieng sympat, klet noh Khynnah tang ‘tien ieit bad khroh La poi ka juk haba tang bakla kren Wiak, kumba rung ha shyntur thien. 13 la ka kyntien Rangbah, Sngap, ym kwah, Namar jingstad thymmai jabieng tawah, Ki Sngew Jingsneng jongki men barim, La Sngap, Sha lyndet pat, da’ tien tim. Ka por ka la kylla, barabor ki ong. Hynrei kim tip sha juh hi, poi ka thong, Wat ong, wat sngewstad ne sngew sarong. Namar riew Rangbah, ia baroh-u la dep prong. “BALEI SHA” Ah: balei sha nga shu lyng-a Katba jingmut jingpyrkhat, sawa Kaei ban lah teng-teng yn tip bha Dei mo ka jinglong marwei, ne, shida.

Jingeh ha jingim, baroh ia kynduh Ha ki lok ki jor kumno yn iathuh Baroh jingshem, lok kim salia Long pynban kum ki jingwit ne jingthlia Ha la marwei la shong pyrkhat bha Khamtam ki jingjia ba kham kynsha Hangno yn phia, hangno yn ong, Marwei iaid khapbrip, kumba sarong. Teng teng ha jingjia, tyngkan weibriew Hangne lei lei nang eh, hano ban phylliew Kumba jinglong briew, sngewkwah phIa Teng teng pat ioh shah thuh-khana. Jingshem u bynriew ha la ka jingim; Lada shem lanot, la sdang shah sin Haba shembha, kmen, sngewbha Khongwaifi ktien pat thuhkhana. Ka jingim u briew ha snieh pyrthei Ka pher te shisha uwei na uwei Kumno u leh pynjan ha ka jingiadei Kane baroh ka shong ha la marwei. 14 La katta ruh kum u briew lyng-a La kamram ki tip, wan jingkynpha Ha jingkynduh, ka por kan batai La marwei shisha kein, yn khuslai lei. “KA SHIM JAID LONGKMIE” Ko khun Khasi Khara, dustur u longshuwa l-kumba riew mynta kwah pynkylla, Ne kane ka thew tang spah, ym ia jaid shisha Lada kumta, to khmih bniah ioh babe kylla. La ha ka ri, ka leh ia ka bakla, Bale! tang khun khadduh ioh bynta, La katta, riwar, ym kumne shisha la spah iasam hapdeng shipara. Ha ri war ym pher khun kynthei, shynrang, la bynta ba dei la sam naphang Kumta ia dustur kiwei yn nai bud la dustur ha la ri, to ia pynpur.

Hooid; ka spah jong kmie, kpa to iasam Kane hapdeng jingiasngewthuh shipara Khnang dustur yn ym hap kylla Ba la buh la seng u longshuwa. Khasi i’u Rangbah u ong “U Khad-ar-bor” la kynthei batlot u khot la ‘shibor’ Ha iing ka kmie u kpa ki shongdor Namar ia ka, shabar kin ym kheih kor. Sha iing kynthei, u shynrang u leit barabor, Namar iu khia ka wait baroh ki kheifi-kor Da burom akor shong kha ki l^iew kor, Ym don ba-nud ia u ban leh khlem akor. Khyllah jaid bun Khana, sngew barabor, Kumno ki kynthei briew ki shah thomor 15 Hynrei kumne khana ym don ha ri jong ngi. Namar ia jingshyrkhei ym ioh prat lynti. Ko Khun Khasi ba dang bat dustur riti, Kynmaw aiu longkf^i ha phi, pynkhamti? Mynta ki rang phi long khi ha la ri, Ha kaba phi baroh, kup burom artylli. Kum u Longkpa ha la iing khun, Ha iing kur burom la kup kum u khi, Uba don la ka bynta ban peit ban ri, Ha iing khun ne ha iing kur ruh hi. Ha ri ym don ban ong “U khun khlem kpa” Niamar ka kur, kin ym ai iathuhkhana, La kum bakla para kynthei ia jong hi, Ka Jaid ka khong ka kit ka bah tylli.

Haba phai sha jingshim Jaid Jong ngi U Khasi hyndai ym dei bakla, te phi Namar haba pynshong dor mynta To ngin peit bniah ia puriskam shisha. Iathuhkhana shaphang ka NAM. phylla U ong, “da Jri da khah, sha bnai", lyngba” Hynrei kine baroh khana, long kum pharshi U khwai shynreh, kynting mawsan, puh shi lum pyni Ko para, wat pyrkhat ia ka Jingpynkylla Kaei ba la buh u hyndai ym bakla Baroh mynta Jingstad da la khmat iohi, Jaid bynriew Khasi, hyndai kin ieng sakhi. Sa, shisien ha Jingpyrkhat ngan prong, Don mo ka kynthei briew ban ong, “Nga ieid ia i kiaw, ym i mei la Jong” To pynshong dor ha la marwei Ha Jinglong tymmen bad no phin shong “I pyrsa kurim he i khun kynthei la Jong?. “THEI BA DANG SOTTI” Hangno don niam ban pynshisha? la jinglong sotti shisha ki thei samla Dei tang ha shad Khasi, pyrthei haduh mynta Ha lympung tang kita, ioh ahim bynta. Ka niam ba dang synshar da “kyntien" la jing-ia-smai ki dang sheptieng • “Ka kyntien" ki khot ia ka “Juban-lak Shi kyntien” ka thew ia jinglong briew phak Naduh ka riam ka belt Jdng ki, pyni Pansngiat ksiar, rupa ha khlieh jong ki Jingdeng kordor baroh na iing, ki sei Ha shadem pynpur ban phuh ki thei. Haba peit bniah shisha, te phi ia ki, la Jingsotti, kum syiem ki khein ruh hi Wat ki rang-khad-ar bor kin pyni la theisoti, shad ker pyllun, da, ia ki. “KI KHUN KHLEM U KPA” Katba dangrit, ba pli kim sngewthuh bha Tad sha skul ki sdang ban leit mynta Haba iohi ia ki kmie ki kpa jong kiwei Ki sngew myllung namar dong tang i mei Katba da sdang sngewthuh jinglong jong ki Ki dei ki khun khlem u kpa ruh hi Ha la marwei ha la ki jingpyrkhat Kaei kaba jia, kim kwah tip palat. Lada duh lut ia jinghikai ba ai u Rangbah Namar ki tip kum riew kynthei kam lah Khamtam ia khun shynrang, ha jingialehkai Jingshem jong u ha jngim, kumno ia kiwei batai. Hynrei jinglong shynrang jongka kin bud la riat ia ram kum ka, kin tur Wat ha tyrpeng ka khia, ka jingkit Hynrei khmat samrkhie ia ki kam lip. Lada bakla lei ka kren, ktien ki ong, “Katba ngi dang rit, shano phi don”? Mynta la tymmen, u syngkai, u la kdor, Haba kumne Jingim, kumno pynshongdor? "JINGLONG KHYNNAH” Ha jingiaid jong ki por, ki samoi Jinglong khynnah ha jingkynmaw kyrsoi Ha iing la jong: hynmen bad para Kumta hapoh jingsynshar i mei i pa. Ha por skul te, bon. kam la shu ieh, Np.'nar sha sku! ia ky'kie:!, Ha Ka por shuli to baroh -.'sgevvaha hi Namar ioh ban iate*"<'.ai baroh shi sngt.

Ha jingthiah pat sdang iathuhkhana, Ya ka ban shem ne iohsngew pYiyila 26 Sdang sa ka risa, hynrei imei i pa Na ka jingthait jong ki sdang pyrta. Jingim shida, ym kum por mynta, Haba tang ha TV. ia por pynsyrwa, Ka khmat jong ki naduh khynnah ht, Baroh ngi iohi, tip, sdang deng lit. Kyndit ki iathuh khubor Jingjia la met lynshop ha tyrpeng ki wanrah Synran lang ki iok bad byliai u paidbah. Ha marwei ka kynud “kum kaei kane khun”, ka pyrta Tang longkmie kein ki tip kumno dohnud ka pait ka pra Baroh ki Jingpyntngen ki per bad her sakma suda la por ym sngewthuh aiu ka Jia ne kaei ka Jingshisha? 27 Dei hangne kein wan lyoh long ha jingim u paw Sa tang ummat kthang ba jaw kum ki’lap praw Kan iaineh ha jingim jong ka man ba kynmaw ‘la u khun ba la kha’ jingiap kala wan shaw. Katno ka khubor lum kur ha ri ka par Ka Khein Kur ha ri Khasi pnar jongngi, Na longkmie ngi shim haduh mynta ki sngi. Pyrshang kren, pyrthew, nangne, jingithuh.hi kan plie. 28 Ka 'mat phuh samrkhie, to phong barabor, Ym tang ia Kur, wat ia ki lok ki jor. Ha-teng ha-teng i lah Shet Shukor! Namar pyn-ia-pher, I tiot ka bor. fa jing pyrkhat, jingrai ha ka mynsiem f kum, i dei, ba donbor kum-i-Syiem. Baroh, Baroh ia-i- Ki Sumar bha, Tang Shu tiot ka bor, ani Sngew pisa, Namar jingim briew baroh shisha Ka shong ka-i- pyni ia ka kyrta. 29 Ha jinglong briew ia-i- dei sumar bha Naduh jinglong khynnah haduh heh ‘rta Tad tiot ne lip jing trei kam Jong-i- Wat ai lad jingong “u ne ka briew ba pli” 27. “PYRTHEI MYNTA” Ko Kmie, ko Kpa to sumar bha, la khun ba dangrit ne khun samla, Pyrthei la kylla, jinglong u bynriew, Kat sha ba phai dap tang ka jingsniew. Ka pyrthei stad, ha kaba jingsniew bun ki lam, Teng teng ha jingdie dawai pynbuaid, teh lakam, Kim lah ban phet na ki lano lano, te, Namar jingbyrngem bad jingtieng ruh de. Ki jingud, jingkyang jongki, ia kum ka dujok. La katta ruh nong-leh-kam sniew ki mutlop, Na bynta u sbai sha ka jingriewspah, Ki briew ia mynsiem briew ki iai rahah. Sa shisien jingsneng pat ia phi kiba la Rangbah To iarap lem, haba phi i ia ki kynllung, khynnah, Wat ai ba-riew-sniew ia ki kin ioh ktah, Khnang jingim Jongki ha pyrthei kan bha kan sah. Wat la trei kam baht, jingioh la ka duna, Ko lok jinghikai to pynpur to pynbna, Jingim ba shida ban pyrto ha lawei, Kamai ia ka hok katba dangim ha pyrthei.
